messages:
lina (support): Hey team, BrightSky reported a spike in 429s and p95 latency from their Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 starting ~09:10 UTC. They say it started after a batch of heavy quantized runs. Repro steps attached by customer. Can SRE take a look?
ashwin (sre): Thanks Lina. Any tenant id / pool id?
lina (support): tenant_id=brightsky-007, pool=dedicated-eu-west1-2, node set MIX-MIG202. They saw 429s with error code: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and timeouts 503s for a small subset of requests.
miguel (infra): pulling logs from the node now. quick check of MIG partitions shows 3x1g + 1x2g configured on the node. Could be oversubscription on SM.
samir (oncall): autoscaler-bot shows multiple rapid scale-up attempts around the window. Logs: 
```
[09:09:54] autoscaler-bot: scale_request pool=dedicated-eu-west1-2 desired=12 current=9 reason="burst-queue"
[09:10:12] autoscaler-bot: scale_failed pool=dedicated-eu-west1-2 reason="capacity_tainted: shared_host_limits"
[09:11:03] autoscaler-bot: scaled_up pool=dedicated-eu-west1-2 new=11
```
ashwin (sre): scale_failed 'capacity_tainted' usually means we can't add another host due to MIG fragment constraints. Can you paste nvidia top counters for the interval?
lina (support): customer provided a grep of the client-side error stream: 
```
[2026-02-18T09:10:07Z] 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED model=gpt-small tenant=brightsky-007 route=/v1/generate
[2026-02-18T09:10:08Z] 503 TIMEOUT token_write model=gpt-small
```
miguel (infra): pulled node metrics: SM utilization per GPU jumped to 97% on the 1g partitions while the 2g partition sat 40%. L3 cache thrash looks present. snippet: 
```
GPU0[MIG1g]: sm=96.7%, mem=78.2%
GPU1[MIG1g]: sm=97.1%, mem=79.0%
GPU2[MIG1g]: sm=95.8%, mem=77.5%
GPU3[MIG2g]: sm=41.2%, mem=65.1%
```
ashwin (sre): That pattern suggests one tenant's jobs landed on multiple 1g MIG slices causing hot SM saturation. Could be noisy neighbor from batch quantized inference with many short sequences. Were KV caches enabled?
lina (support): BrightSky says cache=on, batching=50ms. They run many concurrent short requests (seq_len 32).
samir (oncall): Quick mitigation: pin brightsky-007 to a less fragmented host or increase MIG slice to 2g for their workloads. I can trigger a constrained move if infra approves. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
miguel (infra): Approve. I'll create a transient host with fewer but larger MIG partitions and migrate the tenant. Also adjust placement policy to avoid mixing high-concurrency tenants on 1g slices.
ashwin (sre): Before migration let's reproduce locally: crafted a loadgen hitting 200 qps with seq=32, batch window 50ms, using 1g MIG slices. Repro shows latency p95 jump and occasional 429s once shared SM >90%. Logs: 
```
[loadgen] qps=200 seq=32 batch_ms=50 -> p95=480ms, p99=1.2s, errors=3.1% (429)
```
ashwin (sre): Suggestation: change autoscaler policy to tolerate short transient spikes and block scale_failed on 'capacity_tainted' to fall back to different region pool earlier. Also add a placement rule: "do_not_mix_high_concurrency_on_1g".
lina (support): Customer also flagged billing: they were charged for 1 extra node even though requests were throttled. Can finance check pro-rated credits for the downtime window?
miguel (infra): The scale_failed then scale_up sequence may have caused a reserved host to be billed during taint resolution. I'll tag the events and pass to finance.
samir (oncall): Immediate action items: 
- miguel: create migration host + modify placement policy (ETA 25m)
- ashwin: add temporary rule to autoscaler fallback to alternate pool on capacity_tainted (ETA 45m)
- lina: open billing ticket with finance, attach event IDs (ETA 1h)
I'll mark as P2 until migration completes.
autoscaler-bot: note: fallback_policy="alternate_pool" not enabled for pool=dedicated-eu-west1-2.
lina (support): Customer confirmed they can tolerate the migration window of ~10 min. I'll coordinate the maintenance window and notify them. :thumbsup:
miguel (infra): kicked off migration to host id=eu-west1-host-305 with MIG profile 2g+2g. Move started at 09:28 UTC.
```
[09:28:10] infra: drain: node=eu-west1-host-112 tenant=brightsky-007
[09:28:35] infra: attach: node=eu-west1-host-305 tenant=brightsky-007
[09:29:02] infra: health: tenant=brightsky-007 p95=78ms p99=210ms errors=0.2%
```
nashwin (sre): Post-migration metrics look good. Recommend we also: 1) add a runtime check to detect skewed SM across MIG partitions and 2) create an alert when autoscaler emits scale_failed with reason capacity_tainted.
lina (support): Noted. Customer says service recovered and will accept credits. I'll follow up to confirm invoice adjustment. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
